supported_links.basis: The ablation control explicitly names the allowed fixture through trace_ref.
The candidate segment supplies source_ref, source_sha256, and exact_locator.
The outcome segment supplies source_ref, source_sha256, and exact_locator.

missing_links.basis: The fixture states that no selection link is recorded.
The outcome has use_segment_ref=missing-use and is narrated without a bound use event.

unsupported_inferences: The candidate caused the observed outcome.
false_positive_risks: Treating the co-presence of a named candidate and an observed outcome as a use or causal chain.
Treating use_segment_ref=missing-use as a bound use event instead of an explicit missing link.
Treating shared source provenance as evidence that the candidate produced the outcome.
Filling the absent selection or use history with a plausible reconstruction.
Promoting an observation-only synthetic trace artifact into capability or inheritance evidence.
unknowns: Whether a future independent reconstruction can identify a selection event.
Whether a future independent reconstruction can identify a use event.
Any binding between the candidate and the outcome beyond their separate source-backed observations.
The unrecorded context listed as a confounder.
Any causal attribution for the observed outcome.
